name: @3pt/macos
description: SwiftUI macOS inspector. Not a JS package: this manifest lets Turborepo drive xcodegen + xcodebuild so `turbo build` covers the whole polyglot tree. Skips itself where Xcode is absent.

scripts.build: command -v xcodegen >/dev/null && command -v xcodebuild >/dev/null && (xcodegen generate -q && xcodebuild -quiet -scheme 3PT -configuration Release -derivedDataPath .build build) || echo '@3pt/macos: no Xcode toolchain here, skipped'
